content: Most agent-orchestration tools 'verify' by reading transcripts and pattern-matching agent self-reports ('tests passing', 'committed 3 files'), which agents emit regardless of actual codebase state. Robust approach (e.g. Spotify): don't trust tests alone; run static analysis then test-based verification then independent automated checks in CI, cross-reference claims against filesystem, auto-classify failures and re-verify before reaching main. Need an independent oracle, not agent responsiveness.
